briefdescription.para: aring-style adapter for FLINT's polynomial-quotient representation of finite fields GF(p^n) that are too large for Zech tables.

detaileddescription.para: ElementType is fq_nmod_struct (an nmod_poly_struct modulo the defining polynomial) and every arithmetic call delegates to FLINT's fq_nmod_* routines through the held mContext (fq_nmod_ctx_struct*). Slower per-operation than ARingGFFlint but unconstrained by the Zech-table size, so this is the fallback for GF(p^n) once p^n outgrows the small-field regime. ringID = ring_GFFlintBig for VectorArithmetic dispatch.
